name: Saga plc
summary: Saga plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides package and cruise holidays, general insurance, and personal finance products and services in the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Travel, Insurance, and Other Businesses and Central Costs. The company offers travel, motor, home, private medical, and other insurance products. It also operates and delivers ocean and river cruise holidays, as well as package tour and other holiday products; and provides savings accounts, equity release, legal services, mortgages, investment products and services.
